messages:
Maya Patel: FYI — Heliogenix (trial) just requested onboarding of a 13B clinical summarizer for inpatient progress notes. They insist PHI support + customer-managed key custody (HSM). Asking if we can do Private deploy or if Dedicated with KMS suffices.
Arjun Singh: For PHI + HSM custody we should push Private. Dedicated does not guarantee isolated key control. This is a renewal risk if we cant meet HSM in the pilot window.
Liam Chen: Do we have the model package spec? Artifact type and quantization matter (gguf/ggml/torchscript). That impacts our deployment path and eval harness.
Maya Patel: Customer SE says they exported gguf and want 8-bit quant. They've uploaded a package but haven't shared the S3 link yet. Also asked about canary traffic split and rollback playbook.
Nora Alvarez: Security needs: PHI intake form, dataflow diagram, retention rules, and region constraints. We'll need to confirm encryption-at-rest and verify KMS/HSM integration approach. Please ask them to complete PHI intake. :clipboard:
Liam Chen: Outline of our eval plan: 1) run safety/regression set focused on PHI hallucination, 2) targeted red-team for identifier hallucination, 3) redaction/PII masking tests (token-level), 4) perf baseline (latency/cost across 1k samples). We can run initial evals on Dedicated infra while Private infra is provisioned.
Liam Chen: Quick example command wed run locally: 
```bash
python -m redwood.eval --model s3://heliogenix/exports/13b_gguf.tar.gz --prompts phiprompts.json --quant 8 --out results.json
```
Maya Patel: Pilot timeline asked: launch in ~2 weeks. Realistic?
Arjun Singh: Tight but possible if they supply model S3 + intake form today. SE + Security review needed within 48h. Ops: estimate for Private + HSM work?
Liam Chen: Estimate: Private environment prep 3-5 business days, HSM/KMS wiring 1-2 days (assuming customer KMS team responsive), evals 2-4 days depending on failure rate. Overall ~8-10 business days if no blockers.
Nora Alvarez: Also loop legal for license clearance — some gguf/exports may have redistribution restrictions. I'll engage Legal once intake is complete.
legal-bot: Noted. Please provide license metadata and model provenance. Legal review ETA 48-72 hours after intake.
Maya Patel: Action items: (1) I'll ask for S3 link + PHI intake now. (2) Liam to prepare eval harness & canary/rollback playbook. (3) Nora to schedule security review and run checklist when intake arrives. (4) Arjun to mark renewal risk in CRM and propose pilot pricing.
Arjun Singh: I'll log renewal risk in CRM (trial ends in 30 days) and draft pilot pricing for Private + HSM. If legal/HSM delay >7 days, classify high-risk.
Liam Chen: I'll provision an eval instance and include automated redaction tests and a canary runbook. Will post access URL here once S3 is available.
Nora Alvarez: After intake, I'll verify artifact scanning, ensure no sensitive hard-coded creds, and send the minimal artifact checklist. If all good, security sign-off for pilot.
Maya Patel: I'll update Heliogenix and propose Tue 09:30 PT kickoff. Posting intake link now: https://redwood.internal/forms/phi-intake?c=heliogenix. :thumbsup:
